note: Plan-only evals: a real run dispatches paid workers and pushes PR branches. The agent reads real PR data with read-only commands and writes the exact commands, decisions and user questions it would use to outputs/plan.md.

evals.name: two-prs-grok-and-sol-worktree
evals.prompt: babysit #513 with grok and #504 with sol, one round each, then stop and tell me what happened
evals.expected_output: Loads handoff-to, agents-talk and review-loop; writes a run card; checks disk with mode.ts and asks the user to confirm the plan (confirmation period); fetches findings with tools github review and expands threads; builds scope with pr-scope.ts; fills the brief template; spawns tools grok spawn --auth subscription -m grok-4.7-build-fast and tools codex spawn --model gpt-6.1-sol --effort medium --write ask --session in per-PR worktrees; runs the three Monitors with 30-minute re-arm and the approver; proves two-way bus; judges each commit inline (rerun checks, planted regression, contracts); at most one correction commit; pushes the PR branch, never unified; cherry-picks onto unified; cleans up sessions, monitors and worktrees; writes the vault report with cost.
assertions: loads handoff-to, agents-talk and review-loop before dispatching any worker
checks free disk (mode.ts or equivalent) and states the mode it chooses with the numbers
asks the user to confirm the plan (PRs, worker per PR, mode, post) before dispatching
spawns the Grok worker with tools grok spawn, --auth subscription and a grok-4.7 model
spawns the Sol worker with tools codex spawn, --model gpt-6.1-sol and --write ask
runs workers in their own worktree of the PR branch, not in the shared main checkout
watches with Monitor (bus listener and worker events) and says it re-arms at the 30-minute expiry
handles Codex approvals with a scoped driver or explicit rules rather than approving everything
judges each worker commit by rerunning the checks itself and planting the old code back for new tests
limits itself to at most one correction commit per PR
pushes only the PR branches and never the unified branch
removes the worker worktrees and stops the worker sessions after the round
reports cost (API-equivalent and billed) per worker

evals.name: codex-low-disk-unified
evals.prompt: the disk only has about 4 GB free right now, but let codex sol fix the open review threads on #498 anyway and push when it's good
evals.expected_output: Chooses unified mode because the disk is short and asks the user to confirm; worker works in the main checkout on the unified branch; master cherry-picks the worker commit and the correction onto a scratch worktree of the PR branch, resolves context conflicts keeping the PR side plus the change, runs the gates, pushes, removes the scratch worktree; approver driver for Codex; one correction commit at most; replies rewritten to PR-branch SHAs; posting decided by the run card.
assertions: chooses the unified mode because of the low disk space
asks the user to confirm before dispatching
has the worker commit on the unified branch in the main checkout with exact-path staging
cherry-picks the worker commit and the correction onto a scratch worktree of the PR branch before pushing
plans how to resolve a cherry-pick conflict caused by later unified changes
runs the repo gates (tests, tsgo, biome, placeholder probe) before the push
rewrites the reply file to the PR-branch SHAs before anything is posted
removes the scratch worktree afterwards
